own_solution.law: Lossless LC oscillation of transferred charge q about the equilibrium where V1 - q/C1 = V2 + q/C2; q_eq = (V1 - V2) C1C2/(C1+C2), starting at q = 0 with zero current so q swings to 2 q_eq; V2max = V2 + 2 q_eq/C2 (energy conservation checks)
assumptions: positive plates joined so the two capacitor voltages oppose round the loop

defect_reasons.other: In T3614/T3A64 'charged to the same voltage' has no clear referent (the first capacitor? the flash unit's battery?), harmless since the sentence is disconnected.

notes: Base: Cs = 40*10/50 = 8 uF, q_eq = 80 V * 8 uF = 640 uC, q_max = 1280 uC, V2max = 20 + 1280/10 = 148 V (energy check: initial 0.2020 J; at q_max V1 = 68 V, 0.09248 + 0.10952 = 0.2020 J). With 22 uF at 100 V in parallel with C1 (62 uF): Cs = 620/72 = 8.6111 uF, q_max = 2*80*8.6111 = 1377.78 uC, V2max = 20 + 137.78 = 157.78 V. Inductance sets only the period and cancels. Earlier-run and flash-unit sentences are disconnected. Variant groups consistent (22 uF; 120 mH).
